scope: Evaluate push transports for Pinnacle closing-line freshness without changing OPTION_B_PINNACLE_STRICT_FRESH=120s.

current_transport.historical_problem: API-Football Pinnacle quotes stale >120s in 42/48 historical misses

candidates.name: OpticOdds
candidates.transport: SSE real-time odds stream; no WebSocket according to official FAQ
candidates.public_latency_claim: SSE updates within milliseconds / real-time; no Pinnacle-specific measured number found
concerns: No public Pinnacle-specific end-to-end latency benchmark found
Pinnacle feed incidents recorded in 2026 status history

candidates.name: PinnWire
candidates.transport: REST + SSE drops; optional raw WebSocket
candidates.public_latency_claim: 1-19ms published path/TTFB benchmark; vendor explicitly states this is not market-change-to-client latency
candidates.trial: Public demo REST only; private trial by email. Raw WebSocket not included in public Trial plan.
candidates.approval_or_sales: NO for REST demo; credential/payment required for raw WS

physical_probe_16oct2026.result: HTTP page returned rate_limited for demo daily quota

candidates.name: pinnapi
candidates.transport: REST + SSE drops; optional raw Pinnacle WebSocket
candidates.public_latency_claim: Vendor benchmark: median ~22ms, p99 ~41ms / quoted 15-40ms band; explicitly recommends measuring from own server
candidates.trial: Free REST key/no card; public information does not prove raw WebSocket is enabled on free tier
candidates.approval_or_sales: NO for free REST; paid add-on required for raw WS

candidates.name: PinnOdds
candidates.transport: REST + SSE + raw WebSocket; prematch prices pushed from Pinnacle MQTT /pre
candidates.public_latency_claim: 30-150ms push; docs state typical lag <200ms and prematch prices are pushed as Pinnacle publishes them
candidates.trial: 3-day full demo on request includes SSE + WebSocket + REST; no card
candidates.approval_or_sales: NO purchase required for full demo; demo activation requested from provider

adjudication.reason: No candidate has yet been measured from the MATRIX GitHub runner against real prematch Pinnacle O/U 2.5 with the exact 120s PIT gate. Vendor latency claims are insufficient for an irreversible cutover.
why_selected: prematch feed explicitly pushed from Pinnacle MQTT
3-day full demo includes raw WebSocket/SSE/REST before payment
published latency comfortably below 120s, but must be verified in our runner
adjudication.production_transport_until_trial_passes: odds-api.net preferred; API-Football fallback only if quote_age<=120s
